messages:
alex_k: FYI we got a vendor intake from GlacierBox. they attached a CAIQ and asked for a POC next week. they want to do VPC peering and long-lived object-store access. link: https://glacierbox.example/caiq.pdf

lina_s: thanks. do we have their intake form filled out? curious what data classes (PII/health/financial) they'll touch for the POC

sam_sales: sales update: POC will use synthetic/dev data per customer. eventual production will include customer-uploaded files. customer wants creds by monday.

maria_proc: procurement note: GlacierBox is new to us. we need SOC2 report + subprocessors list before granting network access. CAIQ helps but doesn't replace attestation.

josh_legal: legal ask: need breach notification window and right-to-audit language for Tier 1 vendors. 48hr notice preferred.

infra-bot: Reminder: complete vendor-intake form at https://redwood-internal.example/vendor-intake within 48 hours or request is flagged.

alex_k: Lina please triage CAIQ. focus on KMS controls (provider-managed vs CMK/HSM), logging/retention, and network config (peering vs public endpoints).

lina_s: scanning CAIQ: they claim AES-256 at rest and TLS1.2 in transit. key management section vague; says "provider-managed keys". logging section mentions audit logs but not retention or destination. I'll flag CMK/HSM and logging retention.

sam_sales: POC team said CMK not required for initial trial. enterprise deal will need CMK or HSM. if we need an interim mitigation, can we do isolated bucket + short TTL creds?

lina_s: mitigation proposal: scoped IAM role + ephemeral creds (STS assume-role) + enforce server-side encryption with provider key until CMK/HSM is available. require strict allowlist for egress and object lifecycle TTLs.

josh_legal: capture mitigation in contract addendum: "Vendor to provide scoped, time-limited credentials and maintain audit logs for all object access; full CMK/HSM support to be provided by [date]". I will draft language.

maria_proc: procurement will not approve peering until SOC2 + subprocessors list are validated. we can provision provisional access tied to scoped creds once docs received.

lina_s: technical ops question: for the POC what's minimal network setup? peering requires routing/fw changes and security review. prefer public endpoint + NAT egress for short POC.

alex_k: agree — use NAT'd egress to their public endpoint and strict egress rules and logging. avoids peering overhead. if perf is bad we can revisit peering.

infra-bot: Note: any VPC peering request triggers a security review and 2-3 day lead time.

lina_s: action items: 1) I'll finish CAIQ triage and list followups (KMS/HSM, log retention, SIEM integration) by EOD. 2) Maria please request SOC2 + subprocessors. 3) Josh draft interim contract clause for scoped creds/logging. 4) Sales & Alex: opt for public endpoint + ephemeral creds for POC to avoid peering for now.

sam_sales: I'll ask GlacierBox to restrict POC dataset to non-prod/dev only and confirm subprocessors. will push SOC2 link to procurement DM now.

josh_legal: drafting clause now, will paste here when ready.

alex_k: if you need me on intake call tomorrow ping me. :thumbsup:

lina_s: quick note from CAIQ: several questions left unanswered in Key Management and Logging. I'll add: - KMS rotation policy? - CMK/HSM roadmap and ETA? - where do audit logs ship (S3 vs 3rd-party SIEM)? - log retention length?

maria_proc: once SOC2 and subprocessors are received procurement will issue a provisional access form linked to scoped creds and time-bound access.

sam_sales: aiming to have everything to you by EOD today. thanks everyone! :pray:
